operators.customDisplayName: Load wildfire fire weather data from data/wildfire/input/Fire_Weather_Data_2002-2014_2016.csv

operatorProperties.code:
def process(fire_weather):
    import pandas as pd
    df = fire_weather.copy()
    # Ensure numeric
    df['avrh_mean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['avrh_mean'], errors='coerce')
    df['fatalities_last'] = pd.to_numeric(df['fatalities_last'], errors='coerce')

    overall_avg = df['fatalities_last'].mean(skipna=True)
    lt30_avg = df.loc[df['avrh_mean'] < 30, 'fatalities_last'].mean(skipna=True)

    diff = lt30_avg - overall_avg
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'overall_avg_fatalities': overall_avg,
        'lt30_avg_fatalities': lt30_avg,
        'diff_lt30_minus_overall': diff
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute average fatalities_last overall and for rows with avrh_mean < 30 (humidity <30%), then difference (lt30 avg - overall avg).
